scientific_integrity: The standard facet criterion, the local cactus facet count, the Matrix--Tree Theorem and electrical resistance formulas are credited to prior work. The proposed contribution is the complete covariance/determinant/reconstruction identity. An equivalent unindexed expression remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple unweighted cactus graphs only, canonical centered Euclidean realization and uniformly distributed facets; neither Gaussianity of the facet law nor a result for general graphs is claimed. Exact finite calculations support an analytic proof and are not a substitute for it.
title: A facet-covariance Green kernel and exact determinant for cactus metric transportation balls
